707322.t: From καταλύω (katalúō, “loosen, destroy; stay the night”) + -της (-tēs, noun-forming suffix)

707357.t: From κατα- (kătă-, “against”) + πάλλω (pắllō, “to hurl”) + -της (-tēs, masculine agentive suffix).

707303.t: From κατα- (kătă-, denoting motion downwards) + λέγω (légō, “to choose, to say”).

707321.t: From καταλύω (katalúō) + -σις (-sis); also analyzable as κατα- (kata-) + λύσις (lúsis).

707320.t: From καταλύω (katalúō, “stay over night”) + -μα (-ma, “a suffix forming neuter nouns denoting the effect or result of an action a particular instance of an action, or the object of an action”)
